title: В поисках ключа  (In Search of the Key)

segments.t: Focused on in search of the key, Viktor Petrovich is asked to open the fridge. He pretends to need the spare key. Let's listen closely to Chef Viktor and the staff's exchange in Russian first, and then walk through each line together.
Now let us examine the conversation line by line.
'The inspector is here.' Russian leaves out 'am', 'is', or 'are' in the present tense, linking 'inspector' straight to 'here'.
'I know.' Senya delivers a punchy one-word reaction built around the Russian word meaning 'know'.
'He wants to check the kitchen.' Chef Barinov chooses the imperfective verb meaning 'wants' for the ongoing action, followed by 'to check' and 'kitchen'.
'Let him check.' Senya delivers a punchy one-word reaction built around the Russian word meaning 'is testing'.
'He is looking for illegals.' Chef Barinov chooses the imperfective verb meaning 'looks for' for the ongoing action, followed by 'undocumented worker'.
'We do not have them.' To express possession, Russian uses the preposition 'by' plus the genitive pronoun followed by 'no'. Then Chef Viktor responds.
'Where is Fedya?' Chef Barinov delivers a punchy one-word reaction built around the Russian word meaning 'where'.
'He is in the fridge.' Senya delivers a punchy one-word reaction built around the Russian word meaning 'fridge'.
'Excellent.' Chef Barinov delivers a punchy one-word reaction built around the Russian word meaning 'perfect'.
'Viktor Petrovich, would you be so kind.' the inspector leads with the direct command form meaning 'be', followed by 'kind'.
'Open the fridge, please.' the inspector leads with the direct command form meaning 'open', followed by 'fridge'.
'I am waiting.' the inspector delivers a punchy conversational reaction built around the Russian word meaning 'I'm waiting'. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.

Viktor Petrovich is asked to open the fridge. He pretends to need the spare key. Next time you watch the episode, listen for the Russian expressions for 'inspector' and 'here' — you will catch every word right away. See you in the next scene.
